newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKCB Bank says not in reorganisation.
newsitem.headline: HKCB Bank says not in reorganisation.

text.p: HKCB Bank Holding Co Ltd, the subject of market talk that China Resources (Holdings) Co Ltd may increase its stake in the company, said on Friday it had not formulated a reorganisation plan.
"We can confirm that no group reorganisation plan relating to the company and its subsidiaries has currently been formulated," the company said in the statement.
"From time to time and in common with other listed groups which have a sophisticated holding structure, the company does keep the overall group structure under review."
HKCB Bank shares have received a boost from market talk that China Resources (Holdings) may increase its stake in the company after a possible group restructuring.

China Resources (Holdings), the trading arm of China's Ministry of Foreign Trade and the parent of China Resources Enterprise Ltd, held 1.1 percent of HKCB Bank as of June 1996. Lippo Ltd controlled 59.33 percent.
China Resources (Holdings) also holds a 50 percent stake in HKCB Bank's 50 percent owned commercial banking concern The Hongkong Chinese Bank Ltd.
Shares of HKCB Bank, which rose HK$0.60 on Thursday, were up HK$0.35 at HK$4.625 just before the midday break on Friday.
